title: 第7章 与猴子交易太白金星的惊讶第8章 晋升天仙单刷流沙河
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 老猴妖抱拳表示遵命，转身走了出去。
大约一刻钟后，他便带着一只猴子走了进来。
叶云凝目望去。
只见对方虽是猴子，但却灵性十足，毛发也是金色的，眼眸灵动，似有金光流淌，体态修长，也并不是矮小身材。
总之，这的确是称得上“心性灵清、形容俊美”
的美猴王。
其实想想也正常，孙悟空是天生地养的先天神圣，只是具备猴形。
但其实本质上并不是猴子，相当于化形成猴子。
先天神圣化形，容貌气质等等，岂会差到哪里去。
而在叶云观察猴子的时候，后者其实也在暗暗观察他。
此时的猴子虽然还未习得神通法门，但因为是先天神圣的缘故，自然跟普通生灵不同，早已掌握一些神通法门。
其中最为强大的，自然就是他天生自带的金睛神通，可看破虚妄，洞悉本质。
至于后面的火眼，只是八卦炉里后天炼成的，而且还有缺陷，比如怕烟这些。
此刻。
猴子无形之间就动用了金睛神通，看了一眼叶云。
瞬间便看出叶云的真身是一头大脑斧，不过跟他在外面见过的妖怪完全不同。
那些妖怪因为动不动就杀戮吞噬，周身时常缭绕煞气和黑气，散发出的法力波动也是嗜血暴戾。
与之相比，叶云周身则是清气灵光环绕，法力波动更是堂皇浩大，隐隐带着斩裂山海的无上锋芒。
猴子自从离开花果山以来，已过了不少岁月，经历颇多。
并非是刚出花果山的懵懂清澈，所以一眼就知晓。
眼前这位老虎大王非寻常之妖，怕是已经超脱凡境，登上他梦寐以求的神仙之境。
说实话，要不是冥冥之中有个声音告诉他，要继续前往西牛贺州。
此时猴子都要直接跪下拜师，口中直呼老神仙了。
虽不能拜师，但猴子对叶云的观感很好，学着人类的礼节，打了个招呼。
“见过虎大王，俺乃是花果山群猴之王，美猴王。”
叶云缓缓点头，对于猴子一眼看出他的本体并不意外。
毕竟是天生神圣，有此手段很正常。
随后，他与猴子交谈了起来。
交谈的内容没什么可说的，基本上就是猴子讲述自己的经历之类。
看得出来，猴子一路上憋的挺久的，好不容易有了倾诉对象，顿时可劲的往外说。
叶云一边听着，一边感慨，猴哥这一路而来的经历还真是丰富。
要是换成他的话，没有强大实力傍身，怕不是刚出花果山就没了。
不，还没出花果山怕是就没了，毕竟花果山除了猴群外，可还是有七十二洞妖王的。
那七十二妖王能占据花果山这等洞天福地，修为不会弱到哪里去，一个个估摸着至少都是仙境修为。
猴子能在花果山逍遥三百多年而无事，要说暗中没有神佛庇护，那是不可能的。
而这种庇护，会一直持续到猴子成功拜入菩提祖师门下。
此刻。
猴子说了很多自己的经历，一方面他的确是不吐不快，另一方面其实他也想和叶云拉近关系。
倒不是为了自己，而是为了自己的猴子猴孙。
他外出这么久，还是很担心猴子猴孙的处境的。
但他不可能半途而废，如今看到叶云实力强大，又不似那些穷凶极恶的妖怪，所以心里生了想法。
眼看经历说的差不多了，猴子也没犹豫，将自己从花果山带出来的天材地宝尽数取出。
content_en:
The old monkey demon clasped his fists to show his compliance, turned around and walked out.
About a quarter of an hour later, he came in with a monkey.
Ye Yun stared intently.
I saw that although the other party was a monkey, he was full of intelligence, his hair was golden, his eyes were lively and seemed to have golden light flowing, and his body was slender, not short.
In short, this can indeed be called "a clear mind and a handsome expression"
The Monkey King.
In fact, it's normal when you think about it. Sun Wukong is an innate god raised by nature, but he only has the shape of a monkey.
But in fact, it is not actually a monkey, it is equivalent to transforming into a monkey.
Innately divine shape, appearance, temperament, etc., how could they be any different?
When Ye Yun was observing the monkey, the latter was actually observing him secretly.
Although the monkey at this time has not yet learned the magical arts, because it is innately sacred, it is naturally different from ordinary creatures and has already mastered some magical arts.
The most powerful among them is naturally the magical power of his golden eyes, which can see through illusions and penetrate the essence.
As for the fire eyes at the back, they are just acquired in the Bagua furnace, and they still have flaws, such as being afraid of smoke.
now.
The monkey unconsciously used the magical power of his golden eyes and glanced at Ye Yun.
He instantly saw that Ye Yun's true form was a brain axe, but it was completely different from the monsters he had seen outside.
Because those monsters kill and devour at every turn, they are often surrounded by evil aura and black energy, and the mana fluctuations they emit are also bloodthirsty and violent.
In contrast, Ye Yun's body was surrounded by pure aura, and his mana fluctuations were even more majestic, with a vaguely supreme edge that could tear apart mountains and seas.
Since the monkey left Huaguo Mountain, many years have passed and he has experienced a lot.
It’s not that I was ignorant and clear when I first came out of Huaguo Mountain, so I knew it at a glance.
The tiger king in front of him was an extraordinary monster. He might have transcended the mortal realm and ascended to the realm of gods that he had dreamed of.
To be honest, if there wasn't a voice in the dark telling him to continue to Xiniu Hezhou.
At this time, the monkeys will kneel down to worship the master, calling the old god in their mouths.
Although he couldn't become a disciple, the monkey had a good impression of Ye Yun, so he learned human etiquette and said hello.
"I have seen the Tiger King. I am the king of monkeys in Huaguo Mountain, the Monkey King."
Ye Yun nodded slowly, not surprised that the monkey could see his true form at a glance.
After all, he is born sacred, so it is normal to use this method.
He then started talking to the monkey.
The content of the conversation was nothing to say, it was basically the monkey talking about his own experiences.
It can be seen that Monkey had been holding it in for a long time along the way. He finally found someone to talk to, and he was immediately able to talk out.
As Ye Yun listened, he sighed that Brother Monkey had really rich experiences along the way.
If it were him, he would probably be gone as soon as he left Huaguo Mountain without strong strength.
No, I'm afraid it will be gone before we leave Huaguo Mountain. After all, in addition to the monkeys, Huaguo Mountain still has seventy-two cave demon kings.
Those seventy-two demon kings can occupy a blessed land like Huaguo Mountain, and their cultivation level will not be much weaker. It is estimated that each of them is at least a fairyland cultivation level.
Monkeys can live freely in Huaguo Mountain for more than three hundred years without incident. It is impossible to say that there are no gods and Buddhas to protect them in the dark.
And this kind of protection will continue until the monkey successfully becomes the disciple of Patriarch Bodhi.
now.
Monkey talked about a lot of his own experiences. On the one hand, he was really not unhappy about it, but on the other hand, he actually wanted to get closer to Ye Yun.
Not for himself, but for his monkey grandson.
He had been out for so long and was still very worried about the situation of Monkey Monkey Sun.
But he couldn't give up halfway. Now that he saw that Ye Yun was powerful and not like those vicious monsters, he had an idea in his mind.
Seeing that the experience was almost over, Monkey did not hesitate and took out all the treasures of heaven, materials and earth that he had brought out from Huaguo Mountain.
